# Core rules

Families: R relational/referential, T temporal, F financial, C compliance, P privacy, A agent/knowledge.
Each rule is SQL returning the count of violating rows. Pack rule ids must not reuse these.

- **R-02**: Claim service date is covered by an enrollment on the claim's plan
- **R-03**: Non-emergency claims with a PA-required line carry an approved auth (MCI-02 missing-auth denials exempt)
- **R-04a**: Participation windows are valid: effective <= term; TERMED rows have a term date
- **R-04b**: In-network claims bill from a provider participating on the plan at DOS
- **R-05a**: At most one ACTIVE PCP assignment per member
- **R-05b**: Active PCP is a participating PCP with an open or limited panel on the member's plan
- **R-06**: Caregiver rows have a consent window
- **R-07**: Replacement/void claims reference the original; reprocessed claims have history
- **R-08**: Pharmacy claims have exactly one pharmacy detail; others have none
- **R-09**: Care gaps close only through a matching paid claim
- **R-10**: Inpatient facility discharges have a transition-of-care record
- **R-11a**: Every claim denial code links to an explanatory knowledge asset
- **R-11b**: Every auth determination cites an ACTIVE PA policy asset
- **T-01a**: Enrollment spans do not overlap within a plan
- **T-01b**: PCP assignments start inside an enrollment span
- **T-02**: Claim dates are ordered: service from <= to <= received <= adjudicated <= paid
- **T-02b**: No claim dates after the as-of date
- **T-03**: Auth decision due: urgent 72 hours, standard 7 days
- **T-03b**: Auth determinations are made by the due time
- **T-04**: An auth on a claim covers the claim's dates of service
- **T-05**: Appeals are filed by the deadline (PAP-04 late filings exempt by tag)
- **T-05b**: Appeal decisions come after filing
- **T-06**: TOC call due 48h after discharge; follow-up due in 7 days
- **T-07**: Practice locations verified within 90 days (stale directory rows exempt by tag)
- **T-07b**: Next available slots are in the future and not on a blackout date (stale schedules exempt by tag)
- **T-08**: ACTIVE assets are effective on the as-of date
- **F-01a**: Lines: billed >= allowed >= paid >= 0
- **F-01b**: Header totals equal the sum of lines
- **F-04a**: Provider taxonomy codes come from the pinned taxonomy table
- **F-04b**: Procedure codes come from the pinned CPT/HCPCS table
- **F-04c**: Drug codes come from the pinned NDC table
- **F-02a**: Paid lines: paid = allowed - (deductible + copay + coinsurance)
- **F-02b**: Member liability on paid claims stays within the plan OOP maximum
- **F-03**: Accumulators equal patient-responsibility (PR) amounts on paid claims
- **F-05a**: Member responsibility equals the sum of PR adjustments
- **F-05b**: Denied lines pay zero and carry a CO adjustment
- **F-06**: Reprocessing: paid_before/paid_after equal the original and replacement claims' paid totals
- **F-07**: A payment equals the claim's paid total
- **R-07b**: Replacement claims (frequency 7) are paid versions of an ADJUSTED or REPROCESSED original
- **C-03**: Auth denials state a rationale and send appeal rights
- **C-04**: Emergency claims are never denied for missing authorization
- **C-07**: Outreach without consent is suppressed (TCPA)
- **A-04**: AI outreach discloses that it is AI
- **R-12**: Every plan has access standards for PCP in every geography
- **A-01**: Medical-necessity denials are made by a medical director or same-specialty peer
- **P-02a**: Member phones use the reserved 555-01xx range
- **P-02c**: Practice location phones use the reserved 555-01xx range
- **P-02d**: Provider TINs use the synthetic 9xxxxxxxx range
- **P-02b**: Member emails use the reserved example.test domain
